THE RIVER BRIDE PART 2 - THE LAST NIGHT.t: THE RIVER BRIDE PART 2 - THE LAST NIGHT
THE RIVER BRIDE PART 2 - THE LAST NIGHT.short: Ama returned to river, goddess demands price. One last night to decide - love or sacrifice.
THE RIVER BRIDE PART 2 - THE LAST NIGHT.long: After escaping river god, Ama thought free. Night before wedding river rises. Goddess: You belong to us. Kofi eyes turn blue. Ama must return for LAST NIGHT to break curse.
THE RIVER BRIDE PART 2 - THE LAST NIGHT.full:
CHAPTER 1: THE RETURN

Ama had not been to river in 3 months since escape. Preparing to marry Kofi. Night before wedding dreamt water. AMA... COME HOME...

Raining in dry season. Elders said river never rose like this.

CHAPTER 2: KOFI CHANGES

Kofi came, skin cold, eyes blue. We must go to river today in voice not his. Maame Esi: curse not left you. Goddess wants payment.

CHAPTER 3: LAST NIGHT

Ama walked alone midnight in white dress. Water parted. Goddess hair made of water. You took what was mine. Your beauty promised when grandmother prayed.

Take me leave Kofi! Ama cried.

One last night. If love for Kofi true you return. If not stay forever.

Underwater palace gold shells. Spirits offered eternal beauty wealth no pain. She thought of Kofi.

CHAPTER 4: TRUE LOVE WINS

Goddess: Will you stay?

Ama: I choose love that suffers. Human love.

Kofi jumped into river, love broke possession stronger than magic. River roared, goddess let go.

Go. Debt paid. But whispered: Your first daughter will be mine.

THE RIVER BRIDE PART 3 - THE FINAL END.t: THE RIVER BRIDE PART 3 - THE FINAL END
THE RIVER BRIDE PART 3 - THE FINAL END.short: Goddess wants Ama's first daughter. Final battle to end 100-year curse.
THE RIVER BRIDE PART 3 - THE FINAL END.long: Promise: Your first daughter will be mine. Ama pregnant, village flooding. To save child must discover origin - grandmother pact 100 years ago. FINAL END requires ultimate sacrifice.
THE RIVER BRIDE PART 3 - THE FINAL END.full:
CHAPTER 1: PROMISE

One year after Last Night, Ama happy married 7 months pregnant. Every night baby crying from river.

Maame Esi: Truth. When I could not have children I went to goddess 30 years ago promised: Give me daughter and her first daughter serve you. You were that daughter.

Mum you sold my child?!

CHAPTER 2: FLOOD

River overflowed farms, children sick blue marks. Priest: Goddess angry waited 100 years started great-grandmother 1924!

Ama found book 100 years river brides trapped.

CHAPTER 3: FINAL BATTLE

Pregnant Ama entered river as warrior with grandmother calabash and Kofi token. Saw ancestors trapped.

Goddess with water baby: Give me daughter souls free queen here.

No more daughters for river! I break pact with my blood! Cut hand blood fell - mother blood willing die strongest Ghana magic. Palace cracked.

CHAPTER 4: FINAL END

Goddess screamed 100-year spell broke. Brides released as white doves to heaven.

You broke it whispered turning old woman. Love broke what greed started. I was woman betrayed cursed love. Your love healed me.

Disappeared at peace. Flood stopped. That night gave birth to girl free child named AFIA - Born Friday Born Free.

River now just river. No more brides. Curse ended.

THE END OF RIVER BRIDE TRILOGY.
